provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4 (core, Pegasus, Exodus, Daybreak)

modules.name: Cylon Leaders (Daybreak rules)
modules.note: Only one Cylon Leader per game.

steps.text: Board in the middle: food 8, fuel 8, morale 10, population 12
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 1

steps.text: Pegasus board right of the main board (bottom edges level); Cylon overlay on the Cylon locations
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus

steps.text: Pegasus board right of the main board (bottom edges level); use the Daybreak Cylon overlay, not the Pegasus one
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus and Daybreak

steps.text: Colonial One overlay and Cylon locations overlay (destroyed sides down) on the main board
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: 8 vipers and 4 raptors in the Viper and Raptor Reserves; fleet token on Start of the Jump Preparation track
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 2

steps.text: Cylon Fleet board beside the main board, pursuit marker on Start; 2 vipers from Reserves to the box; 4 viper Mk VIIs in Damaged Vipers; add the 4 new raiders
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: 1 assault raptor in the Reserves, the others beside the board; centurion figures replace the markers
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: All other tokens facedown and the plastic ships beside the board
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 2

steps.text: Keep the Pegasus damage tokens apart from Galactica's
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus

steps.text: Extra nuke token beside the board (the humans still start with 2, max 3)
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Exodus basestar damage tokens replace the core ones; trauma tokens facedown, 1 unseen on Sickbay and 1 on the Brig
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Demetrius board left of the main board (leave room for the Rebel Basestar board)
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: A random first player takes the current player token and picks first
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 3

steps.text: Add the 7 Pegasus character sheets
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus

steps.text: Add the 4 Exodus character sheets
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Add the Daybreak sheets; only one version each of Lee Adama, Zarek, Helo and Baltar (both still count for type)
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Clockwise, each player picks a character of the most plentiful type (political, military, pilot); support characters any time
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 4

steps.text: Take the sheet, standee and any piloting token; place the standee where the sheet says
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 4

steps.text: Each player puts 1 miracle token on their sheet; the rest in a pile
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: President: first of Roslin, Baltar, Zarek. Admiral: first of Adama, Tigh, Helo; the Admiral takes 2 nukes
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 5

steps.text: Cylon Fleet: CAG title by its line of succession; the Alternate Admiral title replaces the Admiral card
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: The President shuffles the Quorum deck and draws 1
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 5

steps.text: A Cylon Leader player takes the Infiltration card and 2 Motive cards; shuffle the other Motives aside
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Remove the Sympathizer card; split the Not a Cylon and Cylon cards and shuffle the Cylon pile
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6

steps.text: Include the Exodus Loyalty cards in both piles and shuffle both
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Build the Loyalty deck: {n}
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6 / Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Box the Sympathizer, set the Mutineer card by the board; build the deck from the Daybreak chart
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Add 1 more Not a Cylon card for Exodus
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: +1 Not a Cylon for each Sharon Valerii or Gaius Baltar in play (not the alternate Baltar)
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6 / Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Shuffle; deal 1 facedown to each player (original Baltar gets 2, a Cylon Leader none)
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6 / Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Shuffle the Sympathizer card into the rest
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6

steps.text: Loyalty deck beside the board; box unused Loyalty cards unseen (Exodus: keep the Not a Cylon pile by the board)
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6 / Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Shuffle the Pegasus Crisis, Skill and Destination cards into their decks; box the core Investigative Committee cards
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus

steps.text: Shuffle the Exodus Crisis, Quorum, Super Crisis, Skill and Destination cards into their decks
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Shuffle the Daybreak Crisis and Skill cards into their decks
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Box all Cylon attack Crisis and Super Crisis cards
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Shuffle the Quorum, Crisis, Super Crisis and Destination decks beside the board
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 7

steps.text: Skill cards: 5 decks by type, shuffled, below the matching colours on the board
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 7

steps.text: Shuffle the Treachery cards by the marked area of the Pegasus board
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus

steps.text: Shuffle the Daybreak Treachery cards right of the Engineering deck (box the Pegasus ones)
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Shuffle the Mutiny deck facedown next to the Crisis deck
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Kobol Objective faceup by the Destination deck
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 7

steps.text: New Caprica Objective instead of Kobol; New Caprica board and its Crisis cards set aside for later
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus

steps.text: Ionian Nebula Objective instead of Kobol; shuffle the Crossroads cards
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Ally deck: 3 faceup (box allies who are chosen characters), each with 1 unseen trauma token, ally tokens on their locations
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Each player draws 3 trauma tokens secretly; redraw any disaster token
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Exodus

steps.text: Earth Objective instead of Kobol; shuffle the Mission deck by the Demetrius board
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: Every player except the first draws 3 Skill cards from their Receive Skills types (Cylon Leader: 2)
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 8

steps.text: Destiny deck: 2 Skill cards of each type facedown on its space, shuffled
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 9

steps.text: Destiny deck: 2 Skill cards of each type plus 2 Treachery (12 cards), shuffled
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Pegasus / Daybreak

steps.text: Destiny deck: 2 Skill cards of each type plus 2 Treachery (12 cards), shuffled
steps.ref: Esoteric Order of Gamers BSG summary v4.4, Daybreak

steps.text: 1 basestar and 3 raiders in front of Galactica; 2 vipers below it; 2 civilian ships behind it
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 10

steps.text: The first player gets no starting Skill cards; they draw at the start of their turn
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5 step 8

steps.text: Humans lose when any resource is 0 at the end of a turn
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.5

steps.text: Humans win by travelling 8 distance and jumping once more
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6

steps.text: The first player starts: Receive Skills, Movement, Action, Crisis
steps.ref: BSG rulebook (FFG) p.6
